function.name: env_command_fileControl
function.description: Control a file or folder. The root path is /

fileName.description: The name of the file that you want to create. File name must be a full name. e.g. file.txt or code.py etc.

controlType.description: What control you want to do for this file or folder. You must only select the options from here: w - write File(append mode in python), p - write File, but will over the old data, r - rename, d - delete file, c - change the lines

lines.description: The lines that you want to change(only use to mode c) format: form - to, e.g. 4 - 21, 3 - 14 (The first line is 1)

inf.description: The detail information, if you select the writing file, you must write data here. Also, the rename too. If you use mode c, input empty is means delete the lines
